what_to_detect: A spell cast with an optional additional cost of tapping creatures of total power N or more, shown by the cost paid and the tapped creatures.
near_miss: The same kind of spell cast without declaring the optional additional cost.
record_fields: tapped events on the cost half

what_to_detect: A trigger on casting a spell using an optional additional cost fires when the cost was declared.
near_miss: The same kind of spell cast without declaring the optional additional cost.
record_fields: tapped events on the cost half

what_to_detect: A spell with teamwork is a candidate whose legal targets include those of its teamwork-only part, the teamwork cost being payable.
near_miss: A spell with teamwork cast without teamwork: its teamwork-only targets are not chosen, so it has no legal target where only those exist (has_legal_target false).
record_fields: decision candidate has_legal_target, legal_targets (gen-3 union over clauses)
legality_membership legal_targets inside fires for any targeting candidate in the corpus, and neither family can restrict to a spell with teamwork.
